    • distance

      public static double distance(String metric, double[] left, double[] right)
      The distance to sort ascending by, for a metric name.

      Cosine similarity is turned into a distance as 1 - similarity and dot product is negated, so that ascending order means "closer" for every metric and the caller never has to remember which ones are inverted.

    • parseVector

      public static double[] parseVector(Object value, int expectedLength)
      Reads a stored vector back out of a cell.

      All three vector stores AN5 targets hand the column back as text — SQL Server's VECTOR, PostgreSQL's vector, and SQLite's JSON blob — so the in-memory fallback parses the same [0.1, 0.2] form. A row whose length does not match the query vector yields null rather than a silently wrong score.

      Parameters:
      expectedLength - the query vector's length, or 0 to accept any length

    • formatVector
